scope: Bounded review of Equinix Q2 2026 primary disclosures. Portfolio expansion classes, planned opening dates and aggregate development totals do not establish a named site's current physical construction.

findings: Page26 retail expansion table gives metro-level future capacity/opening periods, not site-named dated physical observations.
Page27 xScale under-development rows include a phase already labelled Open; the table's umbrella classification is not a construction-state taxonomy.

Page49 defines financial Expansion to include future additional phases and phases opened after January1,2025. Therefore pages36-38 named portfolio Expansion labels cannot be promoted to physical construction.

captures.finding: Aggregate52 projects underway across33 markets and nine additions sinceApril are not mapped to a named current physical construction observation.

Bounded full visible-text search of the Q2 filing found construction accounting, financing and risk discussions, but did not close named fresh physical status for these candidates. The annual December2025 construction table is outside the freshness window. This is not an exhaustive assertion that no other evidence exists.
